items.name: Pedestrian in the car's path
items.prompt: A pedestrian is on the road ahead of the ego car; is it at a marked crosswalk or outside one, is the car moving, how risky is it, and what should the car do?
items.description: Built-in detector: YOLO person in the lane zone, judged by Cosmos3-Reason, scored 0-100.

items.name: Cyclist close to the car
items.prompt: A cyclist or a person on a scooter is riding close to the ego car.
